purpose: Bind M27's current workbook, source ledger, visual/studio, local-model, and companion inputs into a candidate-only structural preflight without changing its legacy-baseline contract or release state.

truthBoundary.candidate: This preflight verifies only that declared local structural inputs resolve together in the captured Git revision; it is not a human review, learner-mastery, or publication result.
